newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber stable in quiet late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber stable in quiet late trade.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 rubber prices were stable in late trading on Wednesday, with lower values in Tokyo keeping sentiment weak, traders said.
They said there had been enquiries, including from European buyers, but bids were well below the offer prices.
The traders said October shipment SIR20 was done at 43.125 cents/lb fob Palembang, but no other details were available.
"The market is drifting in the absence of any serious buying interest," one trader said. "There were some enquiries but no deals were done."

The trader said players were also keeping a close watch on the Indonesian currency after it plunged to a historic low on Monday following offshore speculative attacks. The rupiah had regained some strength since but remained volatile.
"Buyers are taking the opportunity to squeeze prices by making low bids," one trader said. "Sellers have been holding out but I think prices will weaken through the week."
The traders said SIR20 was offered at 43.50 cents fob Medan, 43.125-43.25 cents fob Palembang, 43.125 cents fob Padang, 43.25 cents fob Surabaya and 42.75 cents fob Jambi.
